items.title: Air, directed.
items.description: The swan-neck rear wing leaves its underside unobstructed. The front splitter, bonnet vents and front wheel-arch ventilation work together to manage airflow.

items.title: Form follows intent.
items.description: The front fascia and sculpted bodywork integrate cooling and aerodynamic elements. Lightweight centre-lock wheels, rear detailing and carefully finished surfaces complete the form.

items.title: The driver, centred.
items.description: A lightweight, driver-focused cabin pairs supportive seating with purposeful materials and finishes. Every surface and control serves the experience of driving.

items.title: Control, within reach.
items.description: The steering wheel brings rotary controls close to hand. A central tachometer anchors the instrument cluster, with displays and console controls arranged around the driver.

items.title: Purpose-built performance.
items.description: A naturally aspirated 4.0-litre flat-six works with a seven-speed PDK transmission. Ventilated brakes, lightweight construction and a track-focused chassis complete the engineering approach.

items.title: Air, directed.
items.description: The swan-neck rear wing leaves its underside unobstructed. The front splitter, bonnet vents and front wheel-arch ventilation work together to manage airflow.

items.title: Form follows intent.
items.description: The front fascia and sculpted bodywork integrate cooling and aerodynamic elements. Lightweight centre-lock wheels, rear detailing and carefully finished surfaces complete the form.

items.title: The driver, centred.
items.description: A lightweight, driver-focused cabin pairs supportive seating with purposeful materials and finishes. Every surface and control serves the experience of driving.

items.title: Control, within reach.
items.description: The steering wheel brings rotary controls close to hand. A central tachometer anchors the instrument cluster, with displays and console controls arranged around the driver.

items.title: Purpose-built performance.
items.description: A naturally aspirated 4.0-litre flat-six works with a seven-speed PDK transmission. Ventilated brakes, lightweight construction and a track-focused chassis complete the engineering approach.
